from: architecture-generation-input/1.0 embedded location, authority and precomputed envelope
compatibility: Additive offline contracts. Fixture markers are optional annotations, while authority, jurisdiction, temporal and current-binding validation is hardened within the still-draft 1.0 contracts. Existing Generation Input and Owner Program contracts remain unchanged and active behavior is untouched.
forward: Preserve every legacy payload without mutation
Record the legacy envelope as precomputed unqualified evidence
Require exact project, parcel, Site Model, source revisions and effective date
Re-derive or independently revalidate constraints before granting new contract status
Keep absent municipal and parcel evidence INPUT_REQUIRED or LOCAL_RULE_REQUIRED
Revalidate every draft 1.0 record; demote self-asserted AUTHORITY_QUALIFIED claims to AUTHORITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED
Preserve synthetic markers and cap marked fixtures at STRUCTURALLY_VALID
consumers: offline architecture R&D and future separately approved adapters
loss_policy: No legacy value is deleted, rewritten or promoted to authority.
stale_policy: Relevant project, parcel, Owner Program, survey, source, profile, effective-date, rule, building-line or exception changes invalidate dependent constraints.
deployment: No runtime import, database migration, Generator activation, staging or production action.
rollback: Revert the additive branch; no stored production data requires reversal.
